records.issue_text: Org-linked brokers without BROKER_PUBLIC config silently disappear from login listings across all fetch modes when organizationId == null
records.rationale: The diff changes the global login predicate to exclude any IDP with a non-null organization link unless `BROKER_PUBLIC` parses to true: `and(idp -> idp.getOrganizationId() == null || Boolean.parseBoolean(idp.getConfig().get(OrganizationModel.BROKER_PUBLIC)))`. Since `Boolean.parseBoolean(null)` is false, org-linked brokers missing the `BROKER_PUBLIC` config will be filtered out from `getForLogin(...)` results (and thus from login listings) regardless of fetch mode, including when `organizationId == null`. This is an observable behavioral change introduced by the diff.
